description: This Java source file defines the EntityArtifactInfo class, which models metadata and relationships for an entity within the Apache OFBiz framework. It includes methods to retrieve related entities, services, ECA rules, forms, and screens associated with a specific entity.

classes.name: EntityArtifactInfo
classes.description: Models metadata and relationships for a specific entity in the OFBiz framework, providing methods to access related entities, services, UI components, and ECA rules.

methods.name: EntityArtifactInfo
methods.description: Constructor initializing the EntityArtifactInfo object with the entity name and ArtifactInfoFactory.

methods.name: populateAll
methods.description: Populates related entities based on 'one' and 'many' relationships from the model entity.

methods.name: getModelEntity
methods.description: Returns the ModelEntity object representing the entity's metadata.

methods.name: getDisplayName
methods.description: Returns a display name for the entity, typically the unique ID.

methods.name: getDisplayType
methods.description: Returns the display type string for the entity.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the constant indicating this is an Entity artifact info.

methods.name: getUniqueId
methods.description: Returns a unique identifier for this entity info, usually the entity's name.

methods.name: getLocationURL
methods.description: Returns the URL location of the entity's definition using FlexibleLocation resolution.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on the entity name.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Returns the hash code based on the string representation.

methods.name: getEntitiesRelatedOne
methods.description: Returns the set of related entities with 'one' relationships.

methods.name: getEntitiesRelatedMany
methods.description: Returns the set of related entities with 'many' relationships.

methods.name: getServicesUsingEntity
methods.description: Retrieves services that reference this entity.

methods.name: getServicesCalledByEntityEca
methods.description: Placeholder for retrieving services called by ECA rules, not yet implemented.

methods.name: getEntityEcaRules
methods.description: Placeholder for getting ECA rules for the entity, not yet implemented.

methods.name: getFormsUsingEntity
methods.description: Returns forms that use this entity.

methods.name: getScreensUsingEntity
methods.description: Returns screens that use this entity.
